mardi gras.definition:
n. The last day of Carnival; Shrove Tuesday; -- in some
   cities a great day of carnival and merrymaking.
mardi gras.translation: n. 四旬斋前的最后一天

mardle.definition:
To waste time in gossip. Possibly when walking along.
> To waste time in gossip. (Anglo-Saxon, mathel-ian, to talk; methél, a discourse.)
> We were just having a mardle.

marduk.definition: n the chief Babylonian god; his consort was Sarpanitu
marduk.translation: n. 马杜克( 古代巴比伦人的主神, 原为巴比伦的太阳神)
